1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario concerns the alignment of the chevron (expand/collapse arrow) in the Accordion component's header. Currently, the chevron is always aligned at the end (right side) of the heading, as shown in the image. The request is to add an 'align' prop to allow users to specify whether the chevron should be at the start (left side, IBM Security's default) or end (Carbon's default) of the heading, thus enabling more flexible UI alignment according to user needs.

2.explanation: The 'Accordion' and 'AccordionItem' components are central to rendering the Accordion UI. To introduce an 'align' prop, changes will be needed in 'AccordionItem' to conditionally render the chevron before or after the title based on the prop value. The 'Accordion' component might also need to accept and propagate the new 'align' prop to its children. Therefore, these classes and the AccordionItem function are directly related to the requested alignment functionality and would need to be edited to fix the problem.
2.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves the alignment of the chevron (expand/collapse arrow) in the Accordion component's heading. The current implementation always places the chevron at the end of the heading, which is the default for Carbon's Accordion. However, there is a need to support an 'align' prop so users can choose to align the chevron at the 'start' (before the title) or 'end' (after the title) of the heading. The image shows the chevron on the left (start), which is the desired behavior for some users, but currently, there is no prop to control this alignment.
